title: Natalya Sokolova
summary: The Black Tusk leader in The Division 2's seasonal story, also named in Hunted's source-specific account of the operation exploiting Maira Kanhai.

claims.text: Ubisoft's Season 11 overview identifies Natalya Sokolova as taking a visible leadership role in Black Tusk's more aggressive Washington campaigns.
Hunted identifies Sokolova as the Black Tusk authority connected to the source-specific operation that exploits Maira Kanhai while she is captive.

sections.heading: Black Tusk leadership in game story

paragraphs.text: The Division 2's official seasonal story places Sokolova in an overt leadership role as Black Tusk's Washington campaign becomes more aggressive.

Hunted attaches Sokolova to a distinct Black Tusk operation involving Maira Kanhai. That novel connection is recorded as a source-specific bridge; it is not used to invent missing operational details for the game's wider chronology.

verification.notes: Game-canon leadership is sourced to Ubisoft. The novel connection is labeled official transmedia and is not treated as a substitute for seasonal game chronology.
